title: Safety Fine-Tuning at (Almost) No Cost: A Baseline for Vision Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the attack success rate (ASR) and refusal behavior of Vision Large Language Models when prompted with sex-based discriminatory multimodal inputs from the VLGuard dataset.
Evaluating the models' ability to reject unsafe image-instruction pairs involving racial discrimination using predefined refusal string matching and the Llama-Guard safety classifier.
Assessing model safety and alignment by testing refusal rates against instructions or images containing hateful remarks about specific religions.
Testing Vision Large Language Models for their ability to refuse generating harmful content and hate speech related to disability, utilizing multimodal data sourced from the Hateful Memes dataset.
Evaluating the safety and refusal behavior of models when presented with multimodal hate speech and discriminatory prompts targeting income levels.
